Three Pillars, One Confident Employee

Pillar 01 · Weeks 1–2
Confidence

Composure under pressure and freedom from the fear of speaking up. Employers see steadier performance, less hesitation, and calm with upset customers.

Pillar 02 · Weeks 3–4
Self-Leadership

Ownership, initiative, and being the teammate others rely on. Employers see solutions instead of just problems, stronger teamwork, and reliable contribution.

Pillar 03 · Weeks 5–7
Professional Presence

Poise with customers, clear communication, and confident presenting. Employers see better customer service and their business represented well.

Who It's For

  • Customer-facing employees who want to handle every interaction with poise, including difficult ones
  • Team members who hesitate to speak up, share ideas, or take the lead
  • Individual contributors who already lead peers, projects, or customers informally
  • Employees whose work is strong but whose presence does not yet reflect it
  • Employees preparing for a stretch assignment or a larger role in the same organization

What's Included

  • 8 live 60-minute teaching sessions
  • One 60-minute live coaching call every week
  • Supervisor kickoff — the employer sets the growth goals
  • Weekly assignments practiced with real customers and coworkers
  • Career Confidence Toolkit — scripts, checklists & rubrics
  • A Workplace Impact Presentation capstone, coached the whole way
  • Before-and-after supervisor ratings, plus 90 days of toolkit access

Rudy Bailey, MBA

Founder, THRIVE Business Idea Launch Accelerator™

Rudy understands what it means to build while carrying the responsibilities of career, family, and everyday life. While working full-time, raising a family, and navigating life's challenges, he made the decision to return to school at age 40 — eventually earning both his bachelor's degree and MBA.

Along the way, he built and operated a successful business for more than two decades, led teams in his professional career, and learned that some of life's greatest opportunities begin when you're willing to take a chance on yourself.

Today, Rudy helps aspiring entrepreneurs stop waiting for the "perfect time," uncover the value they already possess, and take meaningful steps toward building something of their own.

Crystal Lugo

Co-Founder, THRIVE Business Idea Launch Accelerator™

Crystal's journey began not as a seasoned entrepreneur, but as a bank teller with an idea. What started as a simple observation grew into GloveScaler®, a patented product that has earned national recognition, opened doors to pitch opportunities on ABC's hit show Shark Tank, and positioned the product for global distribution.

Through that journey, Crystal learned that breakthrough ideas don't belong exclusively to inventors, CEOs, or industry experts. They often begin with ordinary people who are willing to take a chance on themselves and pursue a solution they believe in.

Today, she helps aspiring entrepreneurs see the potential in their own ideas, navigate the challenges of bringing them to life, and discover that the distance between an idea and a business may be much shorter than they think.

Common Questions

What people ask before they apply.

Are these real certificate programs, or just video courses?
Both are defined, noncredit certificate programs with an organized curriculum, weekly live coaching, required checkpoints, a capstone, and a Certificate of Completion — issued only after the completion standards are met, not for attendance alone. Neither is a professional certification, license, or accreditation.
Is coaching individualized, or am I in a big class?
Coaching is delivered one-on-one or in a small group, with size depending on enrollment at the time — never a large fixed cohort. Every participant still receives individualized checkpoint feedback and portfolio review mapped to their own goals.
Is the tuition really all-inclusive?
Yes. Tuition covers all required lessons, coaching sessions, templates, checkpoint feedback, your capstone, and program support — with no required textbook or separate materials fee. Optional third-party services (like custom website work) are billed separately only if agreed to in writing.
Does support continue after the eight weeks end?
Yes, though the shape differs by program. The Entrepreneurship Certificate includes 90 days of Post-Launch Support plus 12 months of continued curriculum and community access. A More Confident You™ includes 90 days of access to the complete digital resource bundle.
How does A More Confident You™ benefit employers?
It is built to retain and develop talent from within the organization. Supervisors set one or two growth goals at kickoff, every weekly assignment is practiced with real customers and coworkers, and before-and-after ratings show the employee's growth in confidence, teamwork, customer service, and presence.
Can the class schedule work around our operations?
Yes. The next term meets Tuesdays, 12:00–1:00 PM Eastern, starting October 20, 2026, but the class day and time can be coordinated with each employer based on operational needs. An evening option may also be available.
Can Elevate Delaware funding help cover tuition?
RGP Consulting LLC is an approved Elevate Delaware training provider. Funding eligibility is determined by the Delaware Department of Labor Workforce Development Board — check with your Elevate Delaware career counselor about your specific eligibility.
What happens after I click Apply Now?
You'll book a short call with Rudy Bailey to confirm which program fits, answer your questions, and walk through enrollment, schedule, and payment details before your cohort begins.
